responsibility: Is the build-time generator that parses rs6000-builtins.def and rs6000-overload.def and emits the generated builtin header, initialization source, and vector-define compatibility header. It tokenizes the declarative builtin/overload descriptions, interns identifiers and function-type declarations with its internal red-black trees, validates uniqueness and signatures, and writes the enums, metadata tables, declaration arrays, and macro aliases consumed later by the rs6000 backend and public vector headers.
